inputTransformation: acorn removes comments without changing line ranges; esbuild minifyWhitespace=true, minifyIdentifiers=false, minifySyntax=false

findings.claim: The delivered-HTML evidence loop binds each references entry as `rel` but reads `ref.kind` / `ref.path` / `ref.label`. `ref` is not in scope in this ES module (the earlier `filter(ref => ...)` parameter does not leak).
findings.impact: `validationSnapshot` throws `ReferenceError` on the first `fm.references` item, so any plan with a non-empty `references` array cannot produce a snapshot and delivered HTML files are never hashed.
findings.recommendation: Iterate `for (const ref of fm.references || [])` (or use `rel` consistently in the condition and `addFile(resolve(planDir, rel.path))`).
findings.reproduction: Call `validationSnapshot(planPath)` on a plan whose frontmatter includes `references: [{ kind: file, path: foo.html, label: delivered }]`. It throws before hashing that file.

findings.claim: When replacing an existing `userValidatedAt`, `end` uses `pair.value.range[2]` (yaml scalar token end, not including the following line break) while the replacement still appends `newline`. `updatedYaml.slice(0, -newline.length)` only strips the trailing terminator; the original break remains in `text.slice(prefixLength + match[1].length)`.
findings.impact:
`withButtonValidationTimestamp('---
userValidatedAt: old
---
body', at)` yields an extra blank line before the closing fence (`..."

---
body`), which fails the in-packet CRLF equality test. The same extra line is inserted for LF input.
findings.recommendation: Advance `end` through the original line break (the `indexOf('\n', start) + 1` fallback, or `pair.range[2]` if that includes the separator) so `yamlText.slice(end)` does not start with another newline.
findings.reproduction:
The in-packet test `last CRLF frontmatter timestamp retains one exact closing newline` expects `---
userValidatedAt: "<at>"
---
body` and will see `---
userValidatedAt: "<at>"

---
body`.
